Thanks Natalie — got everything, appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple of quick clarifying asks before I submit the vendor creation ticket to AP: 

1) Beneficial ownership: can you confirm beneficial owner(s) >25% (name, title, country, DOB optional)? If you can send a short signed BO declaration that speeds review.
2) Parent entity: you noted an international parent — please confirm whether the Lumenix entity we're registering is the US subsidiary (Lumenix, Inc.) or a foreign branch. This affects 1099 and tax treatment.
3) Invoice remit/currency: Does Lumenix prefer USD ACH (domestic) or wire (SWIFT) for international payments? If you accept EUR, please indicate invoice currency preference.
4) PO reference format: our system requires a PO number on all invoices in this format (PO-######). Confirm whether your invoices will include that field.
5) AP contact and E-invoice: If you have a billing@ or e-invoice endpoint (Coupa/Ariba), include the connector details.

If possible please:
- Attach a signed vendor form (I can send a DocuSign link if easier).
- Provide a sample invoice PDF that includes bank details and tax line items.

Once I have the BO declaration and preferred remit method I will open the vendor master ticket and CC AP for processing.

Thanks —
